decisions.reason: Adding Transak payment methods and removing the need for preowned cryptocurrency or a preexisting wallet does not change the mint price, commission amount, founder share, or prize-pool allocation.
The fiat access methods do not change the NFT ebook format or its unlimited supply.
The existing same-message FAQ Event already requires loading the complete supplied copy and explicitly includes fiat minting and wallet needs among its topics.
Walletless fiat minting does not change the referral commission trigger, amount, recipient, timing, cap, or the requirement that commission payouts go to the referrer's wallet.
Transak payment methods for primary minting do not change the flat secondary-sale royalty or its prize-pool and ticket semantics.
The source removes a wallet prerequisite from the fiat mint path but does not alter SIWE authentication for the separate wallet-based minting and transfer paths.
The source identifies supported fiat payment methods and wallet prerequisites but does not change email magic-link authentication or its dashboard-access behavior.
Fiat payment access does not change badge milestone thresholds, award basis, or on-chain attachment.
Supporting cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay through Transak does not change the required Base blockchain network.
The fiat minting methods and wallet prerequisites do not affect Chainlink VRF winner selection or its applicable draws.
The Transak payment-path decision does not change the deferred Discord launch condition.
Fiat payment methods and walletless mint access do not change the ticket counters, permanent badges, or token-serial referral code represented in NFT metadata.
